headword: {国民皆保険|こくみんかいほけん}

definitions.explanation: The system under which every resident is covered by public health insurance. Japan has had it since 1961.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国民皆保険|こくみんかいほけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧だ。
examples.english: Japan is a country with universal health insurance.

examples.japanese: {国民皆保険|こくみんかいほけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一九六一年|せんきゅうひゃくろくじゅういちねん}だ。
examples.english: Universal health insurance was achieved in 1961.

examples.japanese: {国民皆保険|こくみんかいほけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{比較的|ひかくてき}→比較的：06172_hikakuteki⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to universal health insurance, anyone can get medical care at a relatively low cost.

notes:
{皆|かい} means "all": everyone is insured. Employees join their workplace's ⟦{健康保険|けんこうほけん}→健康保険：18475_kenkouhoken⟧; the self-employed, the unemployed and retirees join ⟦{国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}→国民健康保険：24671_kokuminkenkouhoken⟧, run by the local government.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国民皆保険|こくみんかいほけん}{制度|せいど}: the universal health insurance system
- {国民皆保険|こくみんかいほけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧: to maintain universal coverage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国民皆年金|こくみんかいねんきん}: the matching system of universal public pensions, also from 1961
